h: Self Surrender Opens the Root of Teshuvah

p: Recanati, at the beginning of this parsha:
(בְּרֵאשִׁית יח, א) וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל
(Bereishis 18:1) 'and he was sitting at the entrance of the tent,'
for he did not enter the tent,
whereas regarding Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
That is, Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
the Atika, most concealed of all
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אִדְּרָא זוּטָא, חֵלֶק ג רצ, א)
(as is written in the Idra Zuta, III 290a).
Yet it is written "sitting at the entrance of the tent":
that he would never again be corrupted, chas v'shalom,
and would merit the entire Name Havayah
with the crown of the Yud,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב לו, א)
that He made this rest in revelation, etc.,
And as it says after the tenth test
(בְּרֵאשִׁית כד, א) וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים
(Bereishis 24:1): "And Avraham was old, advanced in days":
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכט, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (I 129a);
and he merited the attribute of "zakein."
"And Hashem blessed Avraham with everything, bakol":
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רִיט, א)
That is, he was then assured
that there would come forth from him
he did not enter the tent,
But regarding Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
it is written "from the Ohel Mo'ed,"
for he gazed through the luminous lens
And it is written, "from the Ohel Mo'ed, saying,"
"Go out and say to them," etc.
(Yeshayahu 49:21), "And you will say in your heart"
that is, that he should shine forth from his level to Yisrael,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, merited
through the test of the Akeidah,
which was a kind of mesiras nefesh.
And so the order of the korbanos teaches:
as though his blood were cast,
as is written in Recanati and in the holy Zohar.
And although the korbanos come for unintentional sin,
for which one is not liable to death,
it is only to merit grasping
which is the Yud and the tip of the Yud,
that was given over to ba'alei teshuvah,
seeing himself as though he were slaughtered, etc.
And through this they can repair,
even if one forgot the essence of Shabbos,
which is the sum of the entire Torah;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַל יְדֵי הַמְּסִירוּת נֶפֶשׁ
he can repair from the root,
וְזֶהוּ מֵעֵין מַדְרֵגַת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this is a semblance of the level of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
and he was the secret of Da'as.
which is also from the secret of Da'as
